description: 多益晨間通勤讀書包 — 涵蓋單字/文法/閱讀/聽力四大項目，搭配 LINE 每日推播，設計給約45分鐘通勤時間使用。

grammar_points.topic: 關係代名詞 who / which / that
grammar_points.explanation_zh: who 指人，which 指物；逗號後的非限定用法子句只能用 which 或 who，不能用 that。
grammar_points.example_en: The employee who received the award will give a speech.
grammar_points.example_zh: 獲獎的那位員工將會致詞。
grammar_points.question_stem: The proposal, ___ was submitted last week, has been approved.
grammar_points.answer_explanation_zh: which 用來指代物（proposal），且逗號後的非限定子句只能用 which，不能用 that。

grammar_points.topic: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式
grammar_points.explanation_zh: 現在完成式(have/has+p.p.)強調動作持續到現在；過去簡單式強調過去某個明確時間點。
grammar_points.example_en: She has worked here for five years.
grammar_points.example_zh: 她已經在這裡工作五年了（持續到現在）。
grammar_points.answer_explanation_zh: since 2015 表示從過去持續到現在，須用現在完成式 has worked。

grammar_points.topic: 假設語氣（與現在事實相反）
grammar_points.explanation_zh: 與現在事實相反的假設，if 子句 be 動詞一律用 were，主要子句用 would/could + 原形動詞。
grammar_points.example_en: If I were the manager, I would approve the request immediately.
grammar_points.example_zh: 如果我是經理，我會立刻核准這項請求。
grammar_points.question_stem: If the budget ___ larger, we could hire more staff.
grammar_points.answer_explanation_zh: 與現在事實相反的假設句，be動詞不分人稱一律用 were。

grammar_points.explanation_zh: 分詞邏輯主詞與句子主詞一致時，主動關係用 V-ing，被動/完成關係用 V-ed。
grammar_points.example_en: Having finished the report, she went home early.
grammar_points.example_zh: 完成報告後，她提早回家了。
grammar_points.question_stem: ___ by the CEO, the new policy was implemented immediately.
grammar_points.answer_explanation_zh: policy 是被 CEO 核准（被動關係），分詞構句須用過去分詞 Approved。

grammar_points.topic: 介系詞慣用搭配 in / on / at
grammar_points.explanation_zh: in 用於較長時間（月、年）、on 用於日期、at 用於精確時刻，但 on the morning of + 日期是固定用法例外。
grammar_points.example_en: The meeting is scheduled at 3 P.M. on Monday in March.
grammar_points.example_zh: 會議訂在三月的星期一下午三點。
grammar_points.question_stem: The conference will be held ___ the morning of June 5.
grammar_points.answer_explanation_zh: 雖然是「早上」，但後面接特定日期時，固定用 on the morning of + 日期，這是常考的介系詞慣用例外。

grammar_points.explanation_zh: because 後面接子句（主詞+動詞），because of 後面接名詞或動名詞片語。
grammar_points.example_en: The flight was delayed because of bad weather.
grammar_points.example_zh: 班機因為天氣不好而延誤。
grammar_points.question_stem: The event was postponed ___ the sudden storm.
grammar_points.answer_explanation_zh: storm 是名詞，後面沒有子句，所以要用 because of。

grammar_points.explanation_zh: 當主詞是動作的承受者而非執行者時，用 be + 過去分詞的被動語態。
grammar_points.example_en: The report was reviewed by three managers before submission.
grammar_points.example_zh: 這份報告在送出前被三位經理審查過。
grammar_points.question_stem: All applications ___ by the HR department before the interview stage.
grammar_points.answer_explanation_zh: applications 是被審查（承受動作），須用被動語態 are reviewed。

grammar_points.topic: 比較級 vs 最高級
grammar_points.explanation_zh: 兩者比較用比較級(-er/more)+than；三者以上比較用最高級(-est/most)+the。
grammar_points.example_en: This model is more efficient than the previous one.
grammar_points.example_zh: 這個型號比前一代更有效率。
grammar_points.question_stem: Of all the candidates, Ms. Chen has the ___ experience.
grammar_points.answer_explanation_zh: of all the candidates 表示三者以上比較，須用最高級 the most。

grammar_points.explanation_zh: must 表高度肯定的推測（一定）；should 表預期（應該會）；may/might 表較低確定性（可能）。
grammar_points.example_en: The shipment should arrive by Friday if there are no delays.
grammar_points.example_zh: 如果沒有延誤，貨物應該星期五前會到。
grammar_points.question_stem: Given the positive reviews, the product ___ sell well.
grammar_points.answer_explanation_zh: 根據正面評價做出「應該會」的預期推測，should 最適合。

grammar_points.topic: 不定詞 vs 動名詞
grammar_points.explanation_zh: decide/plan/agree 後固定接不定詞(to V)；avoid/consider/suggest 後固定接動名詞(V-ing)。
grammar_points.example_en: The board is considering hiring a consultant.
grammar_points.example_zh: 董事會正在考慮聘請一位顧問。
grammar_points.question_stem: The board is considering ___ the merger next quarter.
grammar_points.answer_explanation_zh: consider 後面固定接動名詞(V-ing)，所以用 announcing。

To: All Marketing Staff
From: Grace Lin, Marketing Director
Subject: Meeting Rescheduled

Dear Team,

Due to a scheduling conflict, tomorrow's marketing strategy meeting has been moved from 10 A.M. to 2 P.M. The location remains the same, Conference Room B. Please review the attached quarterly report before the meeting, as we will be discussing the Q3 budget allocation in detail. If you are unable to attend at the new time, please notify me by the end of today.

Best regards,
Grace Lin

MEMO

To: All Staff
From: Executive Office
Re: Merger with Bright Path Consulting

We are pleased to announce that, effective November 1, our company will merge with Bright Path Consulting. All current employees will retain their positions, and there will be no immediate changes to reporting structures. Over the next two months, a transition team will hold information sessions to answer questions about benefits and future projects.
